title: Cyber Aware ca15 trailer, round 1, script R1 (captions only; narrator not voiced; takes pending)

script.heading: ca15 trailer script (Shadow IT)
script.brief: Owner rules (settled on ca12, 2026-11-22): the trailer stands alone as a sell for the training, narrator VO about the course throughout; open on a strong in-game line (Fatima's bark); open card with v1; name the topic in VO over footage that shows it; red chapter card, each step spoken over the footage that shows it; in-game cast lines, no narrator over a character line; blue chapter card and VO naming what to check; ca-close with "Play the attack · Learn to stop it" and the Hacktivity.co.uk call. Spoilers fine, no masks, no debrief cost line (D317), no music until D331. ca15 is consequence-first: there is no attacker to play, so the red card reads "You take the shortcuts" (open question for the owner).

music.note: silent bed until D331; game room sound and voiced lines only
